Experimental: it changes vanilla behavior and is off by default.

LanguageData.MDT_UpdateNotesTitle: What's new in Modern Dev Tools
LanguageData.MDT_UpdateNotesBody:
Welcome to Modern Dev Tools, a modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools.

New in 1.1
- The dev actions search now finds every action across the whole tab, including tools like Destroy, and the search box opens focused and restyled to match the suite.
- Faster first open of the debug log after a startup error: the analysis warm-up now runs in the background instead of hitching the first time you open or close the log.

Debug log
- A cleaner, more readable log that traces each error back to the mod that likely caused it, with clickable links to the mod's page.
- A shipped knowledge library explains common errors in plain language, and a severity snip shows whether an error hurts your TPS or FPS.
- Ignore harmless warnings to keep the log clean.

Dev tools window
- A modern, searchable 3-tab window (Actions, Output, Settings) that also lists actions added by other mods.
- Spawn menus show a searchable icon grid; pin any action to the reskinned dev palette.

Extensible
- Mod authors can add their own analysis and knowledge entries in XML or C#.
LanguageData.MDT_DevPaletteEmpty: Pin actions from the dev tools window to add them here.
LanguageData.MDT_NoIgnored: No warnings are being ignored. Open a warning and press Ignore to mute a harmless class of warnings.
LanguageData.MDT_ExtendHint: Add your own analysis: ship a ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef or a ModernDevTools.KnownIssueDef in XML, or call ModernDevToolsAPI.RegisterModule in C# with your own ErrorModule subclass. Full guide: Documentation/RootCauseAnalysis.md.
